annotations.title: Show my resume as an ATS reads it

description: The user's resume text in the order an ATS reads it, line by line — after columns are untangled and wrapped lines rejoined — with what the layout measured (columns, tables, hidden text) and the parsing warnings. For answering 'why did it read my resume like this?'. Use it only on the user's own resume, at their request: it is a tool for candidates. Never use it to screen, rank, compare or reject other people. Runs locally and reads only the files named in the call; nothing is sent anywhere.

path.description: Absolute path to the user's resume: .pdf, .docx, .html, .txt, .md, or a .json JSON Resume or ats-resume document. Give path or text, not both.

region.description: Read the resume as from this country (US, DE, FR, GB, IN). Default: inferred from it.

text.description: The resume as plain text, when there is no file. Give path or text, not both.

name: extract_text

layout.description: What the file's layout measured (columns, tables, hidden text); null for text.

lines.description: The text in the order an ATS reads it. At most 500 lines.
